integrity: A structural algebraic proof and exact finite-field enumeration are supplied; twelve complete computational instances corroborate rather than establish the infinite assertions. Historical-priority uncertainty remains.
scientific_limitations: Reduced fixed-flag four-by-four exterior tuple varieties; no claims on scheme structure, higher matrix sizes, quotient moduli, or historical uniqueness. Three-component geometry is for r>=2; count also applies to r=1. Field characteristic arbitrary.
title: Three-component geometry and finite-field counts for exterior tuples in a four-step flag
